strategies.name: vwap_trend_continuation_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Trade in the direction of a session bias after price has moved away from VWAP to at least the first, preferably the second, standard-deviation band, then broken back through and retested that band. The example given is a long: after building volume below and pushing away from fair value, enter once
strategies.exit_summary: Use the second and third VWAP standard-deviation bands as profit targets. The setup is presented as a continuation trade after the retest, with those outer bands serving as target levels.

variants.variant_label: Long continuation after reclaim/retest of lower band
variants.timeframe_note: session-based intraday / New York session example
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait until price has gone to the first or second standard-deviation area, then after it breaks and tests the band, take
variants.target_note: use the second and third standard deviations as targets
variants.transcript_quote: you might have a long idea for your session ... wait until the price has gone at least to the first if not the second standard deviation ... after we

variants.variant_label: Short-side continuation is implied symmetric use
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: same VWAP-band break/retest logic in the opposite direction if session idea is short
variants.target_note: use outer standard-deviation bands as targets
variants.transcript_quote: if the position is short they will try to load most of the volume in the premium area

strategies.name: vwap_band_mean_reversion
strategies.entry_summary: Use the outer VWAP standard-deviation bands as overbought/oversold extremes and enter a reversal when price reaches those stretched levels away from session fair value. The transcript frames the lower standard deviations as the place
strategies.exit_summary: Target the central VWAP for price rebalancing back toward fair value. The trade management is explicitly described as using the session VWAP as the mean-reversion objective.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: look for the trade once price has moved into the lower standard deviations
variants.transcript_quote: we opened the session ... we went down into the lower standard deviations and here is where you want to look for a trade

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: use outer VWAP bands as overbought or oversold levels
variants.target_note: use the central vwap as a target for price rebalancing
variants.transcript_quote: if you're using reversal strategies you might want to use these as some sort of overbought or oversold levels ... and use the central vwap as a target

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches two opposed executable skeletons: a VWAP-band continuation/retest trade targeting outer bands, and a mean-reversion reversal from outer bands back to central VWAP.
